new_code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    rim = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)
           if r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1)]
    frame = Counter(rim).most_common(1)[0][0]
    core = [(r, c) for r, c in cells if grid[r][c] != frame]
    fill = Counter(grid[r][c] for r, c in core).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ir0, ir1 = min(r for r, c in core), max(r for r, c in core)
    ic0, ic1 = min(c for r, c in core), max(c for r, c in core)
    core_h, core_w = ir1 - ir0 + 1, ic1 - ic0 + 1
    frame_width = min(ir0 - r0, r1 - ir1, ic0 - c0, c1 - ic1)
    pad = core_h if core_h == core_w else frame_width
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, r0 - pad), min(h, r1 + pad + 1)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0 - pad), min(w, c1 + pad + 1)):
            out[r][c] = fill
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
